audit.scope: Complete original and two-word teacher reconstruction, every causal lift, exact unary/pair/combined marking support, all 36 point-search trees and policy decisions, submitted SMT assertions, and every fresh native computation from the true parser start. Explicit reuse of old context admission/families/frozen policy. One run per lane, no cold speedup or new RL claim.

certificate.scope: Independently reconstructed complete teachers, two-word boundaries, causal restriction and every visited graph. Negative pairs prove only redundant conjunction constraints in this finite grammar. Not an infinite or unrestricted logical certificate.

combined.scope: Exact union of both separately audited point layers, with no t-data or candidate change.

conditional.scope: Literal extra point values independently rebuilt; positive prefixes preserved. A shared candidate writing both forbidden words is rejected by a separate fixed point, without internally inconsistent tile data.

unary.scope: Every extra assigned value reconstructed. All positive teacher regions retain exact marking agreement; unknowns supply no support. This supplements the exhaustive negative-prefix and causal-restriction certificates.

registry.scope: All interface matches to the declared syntactic basis; dependency definitions registered before use. This generated inventory is not yet authority without native acceptance.

reused_context.scope: Reused native-admitted catalog/registry only. Earlier search results and failure labels are not reused.
